title: Geospatial Alignment, Reference Validity, and Uncertainty Research Readiness Audit

bounding_box_corners.notes: Calculable directly from tile X and Y indices.

ground_sampling_distance_gsd.notes: Nominal Web Mercator pixel spacing. Native airborne NAIP was 0.6m or 1.0m prior to resampling.

naip_acquisition_dates.notes: Recovered from USGS quadrangle filenames. Exact flight time and solar angles absent.

sentinel2_acquisition_dates.notes: Zero timestamps exist for the 32 Sentinel-2 frames.

sentinel2_solar_geometry.notes: Sun azimuth and zenith angles completely absent.

cloud_masks_qa60.notes: No QA60 or SCL probability masks found in dataset.

affine_transform_matrices.notes: No .tfw, .pgw, or GeoTIFF header tags exist locally.

building_footprints_and_masks.notes: Zero vector or raster building annotations exist locally.

spatial_registration_audit_summary.registration_claim_limit: Cross-correlation establishes relative spatial texture alignment only; it does not verify absolute geodetic accuracy.

building_evaluation_readiness.reconstruction_metric_limitation: cPSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS evaluate whole-image RGB radiance and are dominated by background landscape (>99.9% of pixels). They cannot detect building omissions or boundary errors.
prerequisites_for_building_claims: Co-registered authoritative vector building footprints (e.g. MS Building Footprints or OSM)
High-resolution binary raster masks aligned to NAIP grid
Temporal synchronization with 2019 NAIP aerial flights

method_1_input_selection_sensitivity.measures: Sensitivity to temporal observation draw (s_delta ~ 0.89 dB)
method_1_input_selection_sensitivity.scientific_limitation: Measures input sampling variance; not calibrated uncertainty on its own.

method_2_test_time_augmentation_tta.transformation_group: Discrete dihedral D4 (8 transforms: 4 rotations x 2 flips)
method_2_test_time_augmentation_tta.measures: Model rotational equivariance variance and high-frequency structural stability.
method_2_test_time_augmentation_tta.scientific_limitation: Measures geometric sensitivity; does not reflect missing sensor information.

method_3_model_ensemble.scientific_limitation: Only 1 checkpoint exists locally. Deterministic re-inference produces zero variance. Cannot be evaluated without external model training.

method_4_error_calibration.mandatory_prerequisite: Must be evaluated on translation-compensated residuals within the 214 reliable tiles; highly vulnerable to temporal land-cover changes.

stages: Stage 1: Reference Validation (Filter 214 reliable tiles, apply cPSNR translation offset)
Stage 2: Uncertainty Map Generation (D4 TTA and 5-strategy Input Sensitivity)
Stage 3: Reliability & Error Calibration (AUSE, AURG, Spearman rank correlation)
Stage 4: Structural Edge-Proxy Analysis (Sobel gradient edge residuals)
Stage 5: Independent Split Validation (107 development / 107 locked holdout)
